# Three.js

Pinned version: **0.180.0**, MIT license (see `three-LICENSE.txt`).

Unmodified distribution files from https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.180.0:

- `build/three.module.min.js`
- `build/three.core.min.js` (imported by the module above)
- `LICENSE` (saved as `three-LICENSE.txt`)

These files are served locally to keep the setup preview independent of a CDN,
network connectivity and a JavaScript package installation. Update both modules
and the license together. Run `admin-tools/test-setup-wizard.sh` after updating.
